system.description:
Though it resembles a simple Shroud of Night, the cloud you exhale here is an extension of your tainted soul, draining both courage and life from whatever it touches.

Spend a Blood Trait and a Willpower Trait; a cloud of liquid shadow pours from a chosen orifice — mouth, wound or elsewhere — and rushes to envelop any single target within 50 steps in an inch-thick shroud. The victim suffers all the effects of Shroud of Night, and if he has never before experienced Shroud of Night or this power he must also resist Rotschreck at a two-Trait difficulty. Each turn he makes a Static Physical Challenge against a five-Trait difficulty or the cloud drains one of his Blood Traits. You must maintain total concentration to hold him; if you are attacked, the cloud rushes back to you. Recalling it voluntarily lets you absorb up to half the Blood Traits (rounded up) it drained, which counts as drinking from that victim for blood bonds and other blood-borne effects.
system.duration: Until cloud is recalled or you are attacked
